verdict.rationale: Dover documents its own interview plan, candidate scheduling, structured feedback collection from every interviewer, and calendar integration, so the scorecard part of the story is covered. Nothing shows calendar invites carrying the interview kit or scorecard, or automated reminders to submit feedback. missing for 10: interview kit/scorecard embedded in calendar invites, automated feedback-submission reminders, any detailed docs or hands-on corroboration of interviewer preparation.

support.subject: As a hiring manager, interviewers get prepared automatically — calendar invites carry the interview kit, the scorecard, and reminders to submit feedback

citations.quote: Set up your interview plan, schedule candidates, and collect structured feedback from every interviewer.
Connect your calendar, email, Slack, Zoom, job boards, and AI tools to Dover.
